verdict.rationale: Google endpoint management is built into the Workspace admin platform and covers mobile devices, desktops, and laptops. The docs show password-policy enforcement on managed mobile devices, wiping a user's account from a mobile device, and Directory API actions on lost domain-connected devices. Context-Aware Access ties app access to user identity plus device security status, though community reports say full device verification depends on Chrome/Endpoint Verification and that troubleshooting CAA is painful. Missing for 10: documented enrollment flow, explicit remote lock (only wipe is shown), detail on desktop/laptop policy enforcement, independent hands-on corroboration of MDM functions.
